messages:
Noah: Quick ask  can we collect the pilot feedback into one compact list for product tomorrow? Focus: onboarding blockers, feature asks, renewal mentions.
Priya: I'll pull notes. prefer one-line rows: customer | ask | severity (L/M/H) | renewal_risk (yes/no/unclear) | quote | contact | triage (docs/eng/ops) | ETA.
Sam: adding enablement rec column (docs/train/runbook). also mark demo blockers.
Noah: pasted raw snippets below from today:
- Aero: onboarding spinner never resolves on first login, demo failed -> high, renewal mentioned, "couldn't show value"
- Linden: wants per-tenant cost export for finance -> med, unclear, asks for billing export
- Forge: batch importer rejects files >2MB with 413 -> high, at-risk, endpoint /v1/uploads
Priya: I'll clean into CSV and add impact scores 1-5. Sam, you take enablement notes for Linden?
Sam: will do. mark Linden as docs-first and prep a short walkthrough.
eng-bot: Reminder: product triage slot 10am PT tomorrow.
Priya: CSV uploaded: <link>. 6 rows total, included quotes and recording links. Added impact: Aero=5, Linden=3, Forge=5.
Noah: action items: Priya deliver CSV by EOD, Sam drafts Linden playbook, eng to estimate Forge LOE. I'll ping @product with the digest.
product: Received. We'll estimate LOE tomorrow and flag any items that affect renewals.
